name: Palm Springs Public Library Teen Volunteers
what_you_do: Help the teen librarian in the Teen Zone. You may prepare crafts, help with programs and events, check the shelves and write book reviews.
who_can_apply: You must be in grades 6 to 12.
duration: You choose once a week, once a month or school breaks only.
deadline_text: No deadline is listed. The form is on the library page as of Nov 2, 2026.
how_to_apply: Fill out the form on the library page. You write a short paragraph on why you want to help and name an emergency contact.
notes: Openings come by email. If you do not reply, you get taken off the list. Questions: call 760-323-7323 and ask for the teen librarian.
